addons.atlasloot: the claim that the plain Classic build lacks the new instances is unsupported after the Oct 26 full-source pass (S7 and S11 list the two Forever variants only); needs an in-game check at launch.

addons.details_dependency: the claim that Details! reads Blizzard's own meter data is unsupported after the Oct 26 full-source pass (S10 says only that Details! has a Forever build either way; S5 says the built-in meter covers much of what Details! did); needs an in-game check at launch.
Install size: guides cite 128 GB SSD on Windows and 100 GB on Mac; Blizzard has published none.
pages.blurb: Forever is not the 2019 Classic client. 5 APIs; the beta reports interface 16001 and only a Forever-tagged addon file loads. The Oct 8 notes confirm Edit Mode, the Cooldown Manager (off by default) and a new Inspect window.

pages.title: Macros and settings

facts.value: expected to match Mainline (mouseover, focus, cursor, mod:, /stopcasting, /cancelaura, /castsequence); untested in the live client per every macro site
/cast with no rank casts the highest known rank (guide claim)
action bars do not auto-upgrade when a new rank is trained; the old rank stays until re-dragged (guide claim)
255 characters; #showtooltip for the icon
advances only on a successful cast; one target condition covers the whole sequence (guide claim)
a pinned low rank is a mana trap, not a trick, because downranks lose spell power and proc chance (Oct 1 notes)

rank 7 water is Crystal Water (10) per a spellbook site and the client list, while Wowhead prints a tuning template at water ranks 5 to 7; rank 6 food is Sweet Rolls, 20 per the spellbook site and 22 per the Wowhead tooltip; item 5350 Conjured Water (item level 5, 151 mana over 18 s) is rank 1 water per one item site, and the Wowhead rank 1 spell text (20 bottles of water) matches that item name
/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(92459)) prints true or false for Friend of the Kirin Tor
whether pet spells such as Spell Lock take unit conditionals is modern-client behaviour, unconfirmed for Forever
ForeverDB checked spell names, ranks and commands against beta build 1.60.1.70291 and tested none in the beta; levels for the mage spells come from client lists and Warcraft Tavern
Options, Nameplates, My Secondary Name (Blizzard names post)

classic or modern floating combat text, HD or SD models, free bag slot count, keyring, quest level colouring, instant quest text, show all spell ranks, swing timer off by default (two secondary sources, unverified)
superseded Oct 28: Blizzard's launch guides describe a Classic or Enhanced experience preset chosen at first login (settings.preset_*); the beta-era reading was only the HD or SD model switch
option removed Oct 1; to return after the functionality is fixed
login crash, especially on AMD: Secondary Lighting at Fair or Low from the character screen (beta reports)
the new fog and god rays render only at Shadow Quality Low or Fair (beta reports)
FPS sinking over a long session; relog to character select is the beta folk remedy; no benchmarks
typing Threat into the options search finds the Aggro Display option since Oct 15
/console name value sets a variable and /dump GetCVar reads it back; WoW Handbook says it checked its seven commands against the beta client; the camera thread has no blue reply
150 posted on the beta forum with a ping plus about 50 ms rule of thumb; 400 if the modern default holds (Maxroll: modern default 400 ms, range 0 to 400)
default 20 reported; 41 posted; WoW Handbook writes 40 and says the client may cap it
cameraDistanceMaxZoomFactor 2.6 to 3.34 posted; default about 1.9 per the poster

volumeFog, waterDetail, ffxDeath, outlineModeShowLootEffectWhenDisabled, graphicsShadowQuality (slider stores 3), farclip (10000) and RAID-prefixed variants, checked against the beta client by WoW Handbook
/console GamePadEnable 0 turns gamepad mode off when it fights key-remapping software
autoLootDefault 1 posted; nobody has seen it apply in Forever

first login offers two experience presets, Classic and Enhanced; changeable later in Options > System > Preset; Blizzard's guide suggests Enhanced if unsure (Oct 28 starter guide, Oct 29 returning-player guide)
Standard Definition models, quest points of interest and objective blobs off, One-bag off, Transmog off, camera-turning keybinds, Classic screen UI layout
High Definition models, quest points of interest and objective blobs on, One-bag on, Transmog on, strafe keybinds, Centralized screen UI layout
HD or Standard Definition models are picked per character, change appearance only, and can be switched later in Options or at a Barbershop (Oct 28 and Oct 29 guides)
Windows or Mac with keyboard and mouse; controller support is in beta (Oct 28 starter guide)
L Quest Log, M World Map, P Spellbook, C Character panel, K Professions; Escape opens the Game Menu, then Options (Oct 28 starter guide)
vendors with an anvil icon repair gear for a fee; the Buyback tab recovers accidental sales (Oct 28 starter guide)

pages.blurb: Because the UI is the modern Mainline one, the macro system is expected to match it: mouseover, focus and cursor targets, modifier conditions, /stopcasting, /cancelaura and /castsequence.
